        The Receipts Web Service invokes the Pre-Check In Containers creation when performing a POST to the preCheckInContainers resource.


     Request



    
        URI: http://ServerName/inbound/receipts/preCheckInContainers

        Method: POST

        Content-Type: application/json or application/xml

        Entity: JSON, XML

        Roles: SCALEUSER,Confidential
    



     Response



    Aside from standard responses, note the following specifics for this service:

    
        
            
                Status Code

                Notes
            

            
                200

                OK will be accompanied by an entity that represents the successful creation of Pre-Check In Containers: JSON, XML

Roles: SCALEUSER,Confidential
